questions.q: What is the key difference between `.deleteRecord()` and `.deleteMultiple()`?
options: deleteMultiple() only works on fewer than 10 records at a time

questions.explain: deleteRecord() requires positioning via next() first and deletes just that row; deleteMultiple() deletes everything matching the current query in one operation.

questions.q: Why is `.deleteMultiple()` considered risky if used carelessly?
options: It only works when the GlideRecord has zero addQuery conditions
It always asks for confirmation before deleting, which can crash scheduled jobs
It deletes every record matching the query in one operation with no row-by-row confirmation, so an overly broad query deletes more than intended
It is deprecated and no longer functions in any ServiceNow version
questions.explain: Because deleteMultiple() has no per-row check, a broader-than-intended query can delete far more records than expected — always verify the query first.
